mapper.sql: select t.ticket_id, t.ticket_no, t.ticket_type, t.order_item_id, t.source_ticket_id, t.validity_exempt_reason, t.apply_quantity, t.received_quantity, t.handling_result, t.status, t.handler_id, t.fault_desc, t.handle_result, t.image_urls, t.create_by, t.create_time, t.update_by, t.update_time, t.remark, i.order_id, o.order_no, o.customer_id, coalesce(c.customer_name, o.customer_name) as customer_name, o.customer_phone, o.complete_time as order_complete_time, i.sku_id, s.sku_code, i.product_name, i.sku_name, i.sale_price, i.quantity as purchase_quantity, i.refunded_quantity, u.nick_name as handler_name from biz_after_sale_ticket t inner join biz_sale_order_item i on i.item_id = t.order_item_id inner join biz_sale_order o on o.order_id = i.order_id left join biz_customer c on c.customer_id = o.customer_id and c.del_flag = '0' inner join biz_product_sku s on s.sku_id = i.sku_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id = t.handler_id
mapper.select: select ticket_id, ticket_no, ticket_type, order_item_id, source_ticket_id, validity_exempt_reason, apply_quantity, received_quantity, handling_result, status, handler_id, fault_desc, handle_result, image_urls, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from biz_after_sale_ticket where ticket_id = #{ticketId} for update
mapper.insert: insert into biz_after_sale_ticket( ticket_no, ticket_type, order_item_id, source_ticket_id, validity_exempt_reason, apply_quantity, status, fault_desc, image_urls, create_by, create_time, remark ) values ( #{ticketNo}, #{ticketType}, #{orderItemId}, #{sourceTicketId}, #{validityExemptReason}, #{applyQuantity}, #{status}, #{faultDesc}, #{imageUrls}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark} )
mapper.update: update biz_after_sale_ticket set handler_id = #{handlerId}, status = 'PROCESSING', update_by = #{operator}, update_time = sysdate() where ticket_id = #{ticketId} and status in ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING')

update biz_after_sale_ticket
status = 'PROCESSING', handle_result = #{handleResult}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate(),
fault_desc = #{faultDesc},
image_urls = #{imageUrls},
where ticket_id = #{ticketId} and status in ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING')

update biz_after_sale_ticket set status = 'COMPLETED', handle_result = #{handleResult}, update_by = #{operator}, update_time = sysdate() where ticket_id = #{ticketId} and ticket_type = 'REPAIR' and status = 'PROCESSING'

update biz_after_sale_ticket set status = 'COMPLETED', received_quantity = #{receivedQuantity}, handling_result = #{handlingResult}, handle_result = #{handleResult}, update_by = #{operator}, update_time = sysdate() where ticket_id = #{ticketId} and ticket_type = 'RETURN' and status in ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING')

update biz_after_sale_ticket set status = 'CLOSED', handle_result = #{closeReason}, update_by = #{operator}, update_time = sysdate() where ticket_id = #{ticketId} and status in ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING')
mapper.select: select count(1) from biz_after_sale_ticket where order_item_id = #{orderItemId} and status in ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING')
select count(1) from biz_after_sale_ticket where order_item_id = #{orderItemId} and ticket_type = 'RETURN' and status in ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING')
